injuryReport.name: Justin Herbert
factors: Remains in early stages of NFL 5-Step Concussion Protocol
injuryReport.beatComment: Herbert entered the NFL's concussion protocol following this past Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Jets, and the QB's pending absence from Wednesday's session gives him two more chances to officially log practice reps before for this weekend's game against New England. coachingMatchup.headline: Mike Vrabel & DC Zak Kuhr vs. HC Jim Harbaugh, OC Mike McDaniel & DC Chris O'Leary (Road Test)
coachingMatchup.summary: Week 12 two-sided coordinator chess match pitting New England Patriots's staff (Mike Vrabel, OC Josh McDaniels, DC Zak Kuhr) against Los Angeles Chargers (1-9)—testing both New England's offensive efficiency and its defensive pass-rush and coverage discipline.
bullets: Pass-Game Efficiency & Coverage Shell Delta: Mike Vrabel and OC Josh McDaniels pair condensed splits with pre-snap jet motion and orbit motion to stress Los Angeles Chargers's single-high vs. two-high rotations—widening curl/flat defenders to attack the honey-hole between hook/curl linebackers and deep safeties on play-action choice/dagger concepts.

Trench Run-Fit & Two-Way Leverage: Against Los Angeles Chargers's pin-and-pull, counter, and duo runs targeting the A- and B-gaps, DC Zak Kuhr balances four-man pressure with disguised Quarters and Cover 6 split-safety rotations on early downs and in the red zone.

Money-Down & Red-Zone Execution: Third-down conversion discipline and red-zone touchdown rate govern whether New England sustains multi-play scoring drives or yields momentum to Los Angeles Chargers's pass rush and coverage disguises.
Tempo, Turnovers & Venue Leverage: Road Test situational play-calling, penalty margin, and turnover differential provide the clearest late-game swing factors for both coaching staffs.

keyMatchupsMatrix.unitMatchup: Tommy DeVito, Hunter Henry & Mack Hollins vs. CB Cam Hart & LB Tuli Tuipulotu
keyMatchupsMatrix.statComparison: NE: #13 Pass Off (233.6 yds) · #10 Off. Scoring (+2.15) | LAC: #22 Pass Def (+3.48)
keyMatchupsMatrix.tacticalDetail: Tommy DeVito, Hunter Henry & Mack Hollins attack the intermediate seams and middle-of-the-field leverage windows against Los Angeles Chargers's #22 pass defense (+3.48). Winning early-down timing throws keeps New England's offense ahead of the chains and punishes disguised single-high rotations.
keyMatchupsMatrix.filmTell: Watch Tommy DeVito (#16) scanning Chargers's deep safeties at the snap—when LB Tuli Tuipulotu widens to take away the crossers, the intermediate seam opens immediately for Hunter Henry (#85).

keyMatchupsMatrix.unitMatchup: Milton Williams, Dre'Mont Jones & Cory Durden vs. QB Justin Herbert & OT Joe Alt
keyMatchupsMatrix.statComparison: NE: #16 Def Sacks (2.3/gm) | LAC: #16 Pass Protection (6.5%)
keyMatchupsMatrix.tacticalDetail: Milton Williams, Dre'Mont Jones & Cory Durden lead New England's #16 NFL pass rush (2.3/gm) against Los Angeles Chargers's #16 pass-protection unit (6.5%). Collapsing the interior pocket without sending extra blitzers lets Patriots keep seven defenders in coverage.
keyMatchupsMatrix.filmTell: On 3rd-and-6+, watch whether Milton Williams (#97) draw chip help from Chargers's tight ends or backs—creating 1-on-1 rush lanes inside for Dre'Mont Jones (#5).

keyMatchupsMatrix.unitMatchup: Christian Gonzalez, Kevin Byard & Christian Elliss vs. WR Ladd McConkey & QB Justin Herbert
keyMatchupsMatrix.statComparison: NE: #27 Pass Def (+4.59) | LAC: #29 Pass Off (164.7 yds)
keyMatchupsMatrix.tacticalDetail: Christian Gonzalez, Kevin Byard & Christian Elliss anchor New England's #27 pass defense (+4.59) against WR Ladd McConkey and Los Angeles Chargers's #29 passing attack (164.7 yds). Limiting explosive 20+ yard chunk plays forces Chargers into sustained red-zone drives.
keyMatchupsMatrix.filmTell: Track Christian Gonzalez (#0) at the top of routes against WR Ladd McConkey: press-bail alignment with safety help over the top takes away QB Justin Herbert's preferred isolation shots.

keyMatchupsMatrix.unitMatchup: Rhamondre Stevenson & Reggie Gilliam vs. Chargers Front Seven & LB Tuli Tuipulotu
keyMatchupsMatrix.statComparison: NE: #13 Rush Off (114.0 yds) | LAC: #12 Rush Def (-1.08)
keyMatchupsMatrix.tacticalDetail: Rhamondre Stevenson & Reggie Gilliam test Los Angeles Chargers's #12 run defense (-1.08) with horizontal stretch and interior cutback lanes. Generating 4.5+ yards on first down unlocks play-action explosives and neutralizes Chargers's pass-rush packages.
keyMatchupsMatrix.filmTell: Watch whether Chargers's linebackers over-pursue motion to the perimeter—opening decisive backside B-gap cutback lanes for Rhamondre Stevenson (#38).

keyMatchupsMatrix.unitMatchup: Jared Wilson, Will Campbell & Morgan Moses vs. DT Teair Tart & Chargers Simulated Pressures
keyMatchupsMatrix.statComparison: NE: #16 Pass Protection (6.0%) | LAC: #16 Def Sacks (2.4/gm)
keyMatchupsMatrix.tacticalDetail: Jared Wilson, Will Campbell & Morgan Moses protect Tommy DeVito (#16 protection at 6.0%) against DT Teair Tart and Los Angeles Chargers's #16 pass rush (2.4/gm). Passing off interior twists and simulated blitzes cleanly determines late-down conversion efficiency.
keyMatchupsMatrix.filmTell: Watch Jared Wilson (#55) on obvious passing downs—if DT Teair Tart cannot win clean around the arc, Chargers must dial up interior stunts that stress Will Campbell (#66).
